title: 第213章 不同意见
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

突然冲出的虎狼之兵着实令铁先生感到意外，倒不是因为害怕，只觉得好笑而已，安阳还有多少守军他心里有数，这么点人说实在的，跟螳臂当车也差不多，不过这份忠军报国的热情还是值得称赞的。

铁先生冰冷的注视着这群待宰羔羊，大手一挥，身后十万大军如同洪水一般压进。

城楼上，虞明基金装玉裹，以一个王者该有的姿态注视着战场，过往的记忆碎片交织如布，刀光剑影之间仿佛又回到了曾经那个属于他的峥嵘岁月，垂暮之年还能亲身体验战场真不知该幸还是该悲。

身后那些哆哆嗦嗦的大臣们故作镇定的看着，祈祷天降奇迹。

虞成国双眼发直，嘴唇干瘪，似乎也在祷告着战争快些结束，并且承国取得胜利，毕竟铁蹄践踏着是他梦寐以求的土地。

随着战斗深入，虞成国似乎看见一道熟悉的身影，似曾相识又那么陌生，他不该是这个样子啊！

“他是……”

虞成国边看边喃喃说了句，声音很小，但却没逃过虞明基的耳朵。

虞明基眼角看了眼身旁的苗阔，后者微微点头，由此展开了这对父子间既短暂又漫长的对话。

“承国，你认得那个带兵之人？”

虞明基沉着脸道。

虞成国身子一震，干笑一声：“父皇说的什么，儿臣听不懂！”

“你真的听不懂吗，朕说的就是那指挥作战的中年将领，你可认得？”

“呃……他……他……”

虞成国支支吾吾半天也没说出什么来，其实他已经认出带兵之人就是铁先生，只是不明白他怎么就成了北燕军的将领，真为虞成国的智商感到北燕，事实一目了然，他还不得要领。

“你不认得？这倒奇怪了，为何朕知道呢？”

虞成国心里咯噔一下，如同犯了错的孩子被大人抓个现行。

“父皇……认得此人？”

虞明基冷眼看了下：“据朕所知，此人叫铁先生，但不知其真正名讳，更不知来自何处，如今看来，此人必是北燕人了，朕还知道，此人一直幽居在你府中，对吗？”

虞成国汗如雨下，如今北燕直奔承国要害，带兵之人正是自己的‘朋友’铁先生，这意味着什么无需多言。

“父……父皇……儿臣知罪，儿臣不知此人为北燕细作，被其蒙蔽，请父皇责罚！”

说着虞成国扑通一声跪下，这一跪将他承国第一亲王的体面压在身下。

“呵呵……真像究竟如何，朕不想知道，至少现在不想知道，待这一切结束后希望你能给朕一个说法，给天下一个交代！”

说完，虞明基再不理会，而虞成国也知道其中厉害，长跪不起，希望以此消除他留下的负面影响。

就在安阳大战的同时，常胜派出的信使正飞奔向雁门关将安阳发生的一切告知楚穆和靳轩，等到信使赶到雁门关时已经是事发的第四天夜晚。

这日夜里，天气冷的厉害，天空中不见月亮与星辰，真实的黑夜压抑的让人喘不过来气。

经过一番争论后，众将官们刚要走，屁股还没抬起来，就听门外大喊：“报……京城五百里加急军报！”

众人你看看我，我看看你，不明白堂堂帝都安阳好端端的哪来的军报，而靳轩听了这几个字后，心跟着提了起来。

信使风尘仆仆，满身灰尘的跑进营帐，跌跌撞撞得跪趴在地：“王爷，大事不好，北燕军突袭京城，天子被困王城！”

这话可了不得，天子被困可不是小事，说白了，这群人就是为了天子战斗，如今主子被困，一时间群龙无首，天塌下来一般。

content_en:
Page (1/3)

The tiger and wolf soldiers that suddenly rushed out really surprised Mr. Tie. It was not because he was scared, he just found it funny. He knew how many defenders there were in Anyang. To be honest, with such a small number of people, it was almost the same as using a mantis as a chariot. However, his enthusiasm for serving the country by loyal troops is still worthy of praise.

Mr. Tie stared coldly at the group of lambs waiting to be slaughtered. With a wave of his hand, the 100,000 troops behind him pressed in like a flood.

On the tower, Yu Mingjin was dressed in jade, gazing at the battlefield as a king should. Fragments of memories from the past were intertwined like cloth, and the flash of swords and shadows seemed to bring him back to the glorious years that once belonged to him. I don't know whether he is lucky or sad to be able to experience the battlefield in his old age.

The trembling ministers behind him pretended to be calm and looked on, praying for a miracle from heaven.

Yu Chengguo's eyes were straight and his lips were dry. He seemed to be praying that the war would end soon and that Chengguo would win. After all, the iron hoof was trampling on the land he dreamed of.

As the battle deepened, Yu Chengguo seemed to see a familiar figure. It seemed familiar yet so strange. He shouldn't be like this!

"He is..."

Yu Chengguo murmured something while watching, his voice was very low, but it did not escape Yu Mingji's ears.

Yu Mingji glanced at Miao Kuo beside him from the corner of his eyes. The latter nodded slightly, thus starting a short but long conversation between father and son.

"Chengguo, do you recognize the man leading the troops?"

Yu Mingji said calmly.

Yu Chengguo trembled and laughed dryly: "My father can't understand what my father said!"

"You really don't understand? I'm talking about the middle-aged general who commanded the battle. Do you recognize it?"

"Uh...he...he..."

Yu Chengguo hesitated for a long time without saying anything. In fact, he had recognized that the man leading the troops was Mr. Tie, but he didn't understand how he became the general of the Beiyan Army. I was really impressed by Yu Chengguo's intelligence in Beiyan. The facts were clear at a glance, but he still couldn't figure it out.

"You don't recognize it? This is strange. Why do I know it?"

Yu Chengguo's heart skipped a beat, like a child who made a mistake and was caught by an adult.

"Father...recognize this person?"

Yu Mingji looked at him coldly: "As far as I know, this person is called Mr. Tie, but I don't know his real name, let alone where he comes from. Now it seems that this person must be from Beiyan. I also know that this person has been living in seclusion in your house, right?"

Yu Chengguo is sweating like rain. Now Beiyan is heading straight for Chengguo's key points. The person leading the army is his 'friend' Mr. Tie. There is no need to say what this means.

"Father...Father...I know my crime. I didn't know that this person was working for Bei Yan. I was deceived by him. Please punish me, Father!"

As he spoke, Yu Chengguo knelt down with a plop, and this kneeling pressed the honor of the first prince of Chengguo under him.

"Haha... I don't want to know what it is like, at least not now. After all this is over, I hope you can give me an explanation and give an explanation to the world!"

After saying that, Yu Mingji ignored him, and Yu Chengguo also knew how powerful it was, so he knelt down, hoping to eliminate the negative impact he left.

At the same time as the battle in Anyang, the messenger sent by Chang Sheng was rushing to Yanmen Pass to inform Chu Mu and Jin Xuan of what happened in Anyang. By the time the messenger arrived at Yanmen Pass, it was already the fourth night of the incident.

That night, the weather was extremely cold. There was no moon or stars in the sky. The real darkness was so oppressive that it made people breathless.

After some debate, the generals were about to leave, but before they even raised their buttocks, they heard shouts from outside the door: "Report... Urgent military report within 500 miles of the capital!"

Everyone, look at me and I look at you. They don’t understand where the military report from Anyang, the majestic imperial capital, came from. After hearing these words, Jin Xuan’s heart started to lift.

The messenger, covered in dust and fatigue, ran into the camp and stumbled to his knees: "Your Majesty, something bad has happened. The Northern Yan army raided the capital, and the emperor was trapped in the royal city!"

This is a big deal. The emperor being trapped is not a trivial matter. To put it bluntly, these people are fighting for the emperor. Now that the master is trapped, they are leaderless for a while, and it feels like the sky is falling.
